items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I went up and introduced myself to him when I got there

ctx.x: This was in '47. Uh-huh, 1947. So Frank, when he introduced me he said -- and I only had a chance

to do one number, because he told me -- I went up and introduced myself to him when I got there, and he says, "Now, I don't know if you'll have a chance to do more than one song," he said, "because the program is so loaded, you know" but I was just so grateful to him, so this is a case of being in the right place at the right time.
